title: Meeting Jeffrey Epstein, a 'constructed' person

tellings.quote: I only met him once. Uh it was probably for about an hour or so. Um, but he was an absolutely terrifying person to encounter.

plain: The researcher Eric Weinstein says he met the financier Jeffrey Epstein only once, for about an hour, and found him "an absolutely terrifying person to encounter," a man who seemed to him constructed rather than real. Weinstein tells Michels this from his own memory of that meeting. He offers it as a hint that Epstein may have been a front built by someone else.
